description: The pressure relief valve's cited data (proposal pressure-relief-valve.md decision 27). orifices: API 526's letters with their effective areas, m², for preliminary sizing with API 520's effective coefficient of discharge (never with a valve's rated coefficient or actual area). effectiveDischargeCoefficient: that coefficient. asmeOverpressureFraction and asmeOverpressureFloor (Pa, a difference): ASME VIII's liquid certification overpressure, the fraction of the set pressure or the floor, whichever is greater, the default overpressure at full lift. asmeMinimumSetPressure (Pa, a difference): ASME VIII's scope, below which that default is not cited.
